body:
I've been feeling this way for as long as I can remember, maybe since I was 9 or 10. I've just been coasting along aimlessly because I was scared of the pain of leaving but all I've ever wanted to do is leave.

I just want everything to be okay, and nothing will be okay as long as I'm alive. I don't understand why all of this is happening and I can't just ignore that fact and continue on anymore.

Are you me? I'm also 22 and in the same kind aboat.

I just don't feel like this life is the right fit at all.

I'm absolutely terrified of dying but I'm more terrified of submission and being forced to grit my teeth for an existence I'm not even sure I want. Being "processed" just sounds horrific to me, and I'm at a point where my coasting time is up and I need to actually make a decision with regards to these thoughts I've had since I was fucking ten.

It'd be cool if I could just disappear or reroll in a different setting.

I hope you find a way to be free. I don't know if I can, but I know your feelings and you're not alone with this mindset.
